H2 sigma/sigma-star (15/25; occupations about 1.976/0.024) contribute two electrons, HCS2 pi/pi-star (19/22; about 1.917/0.139) contribute two, and its two sulfur-rich frontier combinations (20/21; about 1.542/1.450) contribute three. Retaining the H2 pair permits its bond relaxation to respond within the active space; this is a conservative chemical inclusion, not a measured compact-space energy-convergence result. Other C-S sigma pairs and deeper lone pairs remain inactive. Two equal-weight doublets are orbital support; only D1 is counted as reactive flux. The [6,4] coordinate separates HCS2 atoms [1,2,3,6] from H2 atoms [4,5] in the saved L2 exit complex; it does not stretch the internal H2 bond. Use separate basis-specific records and direct CASPT2-F12 aDZ/aTZ CBS, power 3.7. Compact CASSCF/CASPT2, angular convergence and relaxed state/connectivity continuity are not yet validated; inspect the production scan under its unchanged review gates. The outer RotdPy dividing surfaces use fragment centers of mass; their distances are COM separations. The one-dimensional relaxed/frozen correction remains the mapped interfragment anchor scan from the saved product complex. Both grids retain the explicit production distance lists; they are distinct coordinates and must not be interchanged.

Select CAS(7,6), source 18-23 at 2 angstrom: retained C(1)-S(3) sigma/sigma-star (18/23), the reorganizing cleavage/CH2S pi pair (19/22), and the SH frontier pair (20/21). This coordinate-dependent difference motivates retaining the pair; absolute energy lowering alone does not. The 30-to-42 angstrom shifts of these compact potentials are below 0.002 kcal/mol. Two equally weighted doublets support the orbitals; only D1 is a reactive path. Near/far orbital character reorganizes, so no overlap, angular convergence or relaxed-connectivity validation is claimed. Use direct CASPT2-F12 aDZ/aTZ CBS, power 3.7. Production relaxed scans and their existing review gates must verify fragment identity and root/subspace continuity. Standalone relaxation diagnostics are retired at the user's request.
